_doc: Slovak / Czech name endings for the AI pseudonymizer (docs/ai-assistant.md A6.2). A known name also matches when one of these endings is added to its stem: the name itself for names ending in a consonant (Daniel -> Danielovi, Dan -> Danko), the name minus its final vowel for names ending in a/e/i/o/u/y (Eva -> Evou, Jana -> Janka), and the name without its mobile 'e' for -ek/-ec/-el (Pavel -> Pavla). Compared accent- and case-insensitively; forms that are stop-words (e.g. 'áno') are never treated as names.
